nodes.title: H3 MOTION CONTEXT - QUICK START
widgets_values:
H3 MOTION CONTEXT - QUICK START

This workflow chains clips so motion AND audio continue across joins.

FIRST CLIP OF A CHAIN (nothing to continue from yet):
- Leave the H3 Motion Context group enabled
- Load, Save, and Chain must stay in that group or the buttons do nothing
- Load 0 / Save 1, then Run/Re-roll or Chain from there
- Run/Re-roll queues this slot (use it instead of ComfyUI's Run). Approve advances and runs the next clip.

EVERY CLIP AFTER THAT:
- Approve on H3 Motion Context Chain, or set Load = previous, Save = now
  (making clip 2 from clip 1: Load = 1, Save = 2)
- Do not use queue run-on-change to bump the indices.

The saved latent carries BOTH picture and sound, so you do not need to
load the previous clip's video from disk. Wire nothing into
context_frames.

DON'T LIKE THE RESULT? Click Run/Re-roll. Change nothing else.
The retry reloads the previous clip and overwrites its own reject.

When you LIKE it: click Approve. That advances Load/Save and queues the
next clip once. Chain auto-approves from the current indices after
each success. Reset sets Load 0 / Save 1.

SETTINGS THAT WORK (tested):
context_length "22", audio_context_length 24.
24 frames is exactly one second of sound, and any
multiple of 3 lands exactly on the audio grid.
Those are the only two settings on the node. Everything else that used
to be exposed had one right answer and is now fixed in code.

Concatenate the trimmed clips with a plain butt join - no crossfade
needed. Latents save to output/h3_context/
(clip_00001.safetensors = clip 1).

Dark Blue Headers: H3 Motion Context nodes
Green Headers: nodes that need a number changed between clips

IMPORTANT:
- Video context length is a dropdown: 5, 22, 39 or 56 frames. Those are
  the only lengths the model's video latent can represent exactly.
  Start at 22.
- Audio context length is any number of frames up to the full clip.
  Capture only as much as you need to carry the sound forward.
- The pinned frames come back at the START of the new clip and the Trim
  node removes them, so a chained clip is 22 frames (0.92s) shorter than
  it was generated. Any timing you write into the prompt lands against
  the longer version, so a beat written for 4.0s arrives at 3.08s in the
  file.
- Turn Spectrum off. Turbo LoRAs also cost you audio quality. If a chain
  sounds duller or closer than you expected, try those before blaming
  the chaining.

If you have rgthree installed, the Fast Group Bypasser node makes the
mute/unmute step one click.

[Scene Start]
[Style] Gritty Dark Fantasy Cinematic Realism, High Contrast Lighting
[Setting] A dimly lit, rustic wooden tavern interior. Rough-hewn wooden tables dominate the foreground and midground. Stone walls are visible in the background, illuminated by flickering torchlight casting deep shadows. Several barrels line the back wall.
[Description of Characters] The central character is a powerfully built warrior woman with striking crimson hair framing sharp features. She wears intricate golden armor plating and has a subtle scar across her cheek, two tusk emerging from her bottom lip, complemented by lower tusks that enhance her fierce presence. At the table are several large, rugged orc men, clad in leather and metal armor, looking up at her with varying degrees of curiosity and challenge.
[Shot 1] Wide shot establishing the tavern interior. The warrior woman strides purposefully from a dark entryway into the main light pool, moving directly toward a central wooden table near the foreground where the orcs are seated. Shallow depth of field keeps the background barrels slightly soft while keeping the approaching woman razor-sharp. The scene transitions to a medium close up of the warrior woman as she delivers her lines.
[Sound] Low murmur of rough conversation, clinking of tankards, crackling fire from unseen hearths.
[Dialogue 1] The warrior woman projects her voice with fiery authority: "Yonga." (Her expression is one of unwavering command, eyes narrowed slightly as she scans the group.)

[Dialogue 2]
"Why did your war band abandon the others and the hunt?" 
[Shot 2] The camera cuts to the reddish orc as he sneers.
[Sound] The creak of strained wooden seats; the tavern noise seems to momentarily dip in volume.

[Dialogue 3] The bald red orc Orc voice is dismissive and annoyed, tired of the conversation: "Did he just send ya here to be a pest?"

[Scene Start]
[Style] Gritty Dark Fantasy Cinematic Realism, High Contrast Lighting
[Setting] A dimly lit, rustic wooden tavern interior. Rough-hewn wooden tables dominate the foreground and midground. Stone walls are visible in the background, illuminated by flickering torchlight casting deep shadows. Several barrels line the back wall.
[Description of Characters]

Red Orc Warrior (Male): Powerfully built, imposing warrior aesthetic. He is seated at the table.
Female Warrior (Implied/Off-Screen Focus): A powerfully built warrior woman with striking crimson hair framing sharp features. She wears intricate golden armor plating and has a subtle scar across her cheek, two tusk emerging from her bottom lip, complemented by lower tusks that enhance her fierce presence.
[Shot 1] Extreme Close Up on the Orc Warrior's face. His eyes are narrowed with clear annoyance as he stares directly ahead (towards the viewer/female warrior). The golden armor catches a sharp highlight across his brow.

[Sound] Low, resonant ambient hum of a large hall; faint creaking of old wood.

[Dialogue 1] The Orc Warrior is speaking: "The rune?" He lets out a short, dismissive snort/laugh ("ha"), then challenges with a low growl: "What if I lost it?".

[Transition] Quick Cut to a Medium Close Up on the Female Warrior. She holds her posture rigidly, meeting his gaze without flinching. A determined defiance hardens her jawline.

[Shot 2] Medium Close Up on the Female Warrior. Her expression is resolute and challenging. She leans slightly forward over the table, emphasizing her threat.

[Sound] The ambient hum deepens slightly; a subtle metallic clink as she shifts weight.

[Dialogue 2] The Female Warrior is speaking: "What if during the next quickening, The village of Yonga's war band stood alone, left to it's fate?". (Her tone is grave and unwavering).

[Scene Start]
[Style] Gritty Dark Fantasy Cinematic Realism, High Contrast Lighting
[Setting] A dimly lit, rustic wooden tavern interior. Rough-hewn wooden tables dominate the foreground and midground. Stone walls are visible in the background, illuminated by flickering torchlight casting deep shadows. Several barrels line the back wall.
[Description of Characters] The central character is a powerfully built warrior woman with striking crimson hair framing sharp features. She wears intricate golden armor plating and has a subtle scar across her cheek, two tusk emerging from her bottom lip, complemented by lower tusks that enhance her fierce presence.

[Shot 1] Cut to a close up of silent bald red orcs face, his annoyed expression instantly shifts into one of startled apprehension—a flicker of genuine concern crosses his face before settling back into a sneer. He glances off to the side, feigning disinterest. 

[Dialogue 1] The red orc utter with indignation, "Baah...".

[Shot 2] Close Up on the Orc Warrior's hands on the table surface with a single wooden tankard with a top isent made of ivory. He quickly reaches under the heavy wooden table with his massive hand. The movement is sudden and decisive.

[Sound] A sharp, quick thump as he retrieves the amulet; a slight scraping sound of leather/armor against wood.

[Dialogue 2] The Orc Warrior sneers while speaking (He speaks this word with mocking condescension): "Here...".

[Transition] Smash Cut to an Extreme Close Up on the small, red glowing amulet as his fist slams it down onto the dark wooden table surface. Sparks of red light briefly flare around its edges.

[Sound] A loud, sharp slam sound effect coinciding perfectly with the visual impact.

[Scene End]
